headline: BIST 100 Index Closes Down 1.53% as US Dollar Reaches 50.42 Turkish Lira
summary: Borsa Istanbul's BIST 100 index fell 1.53% to close at 11,661.00 points. The decline coincided with the US dollar strengthening to 50.42 Turkish lira in foreign exchange markets.
why: The BIST 100 is the main equity market benchmark index for Turkey.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: Local currency depreciation and negative equity market momentum pressed the index lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The Turkish lira's drop against the dollar weighed on investor sentiment across Istanbul equities.
